card.name: Packets, packs and units in dosing directions
card.fires_on: Small words and numbers right before a unit of packaging or dosage form such as packet, pack, capsules, box or dose. Seen in preparation and supply instructions.

modes.label: Count or quantity before a package
modes.description: A number, per, or a measure sits just ahead of packets, capsules or a box.
modes.example: Imiquimod Cream is packaged in single-use packets, with 24 packets supplied<< per>> box.

modes.label: Whole-amount wording
modes.description: Words like the, entire, complete or new come before pack, contents or dose.
modes.example: Add the<< entire>> contents of one unit-dose packet of

modes.label: Number of capsules or packets
modes.description: A digit in a dose parenthesis precedes capsules or packets.
modes.example: Recommended dosage is 150 mg (<<3>> capsules) taken orally once daily.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward packaging or container terms such as packet or pack, and away from unrelated nouns like zone or teams.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before a packet, pack or capsule count in directions for use.
